title: Integration test script only targets obsolete query-test location
reasoning: The package exposes npm run test:integration as the focused integration suite, but the command only runs app/queries/__tests__/*.integration.test.ts. The review context's linked integration tests are route/auth-oriented and are not under that glob, so the advertised integration command can silently run no relevant integration coverage or miss the actual integration suite. That creates a release risk because contributors may believe integration tests passed when they were not selected.
recommendation: Update test:integration to match the repository's actual integration test locations, for example a glob covering app/**/__tests__/**/*.integration.test.{ts,tsx} or the concrete app/__tests__/integration and route integration paths.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This is the test selection command itself; tests cannot cover being omitted by the script unless a separate script validation/check is added.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a small script validation test or CI step that runs npm run test:integration -- --run and fails if Vitest reports no matching test files.
